{"redo_booking_notes":"","redo_booking_highlights":"What you can expect from the Tour:
Your day begins with a pickup from your designated Perth hotel location, where your tour will commence with a 90min (1.5 hour) journey to the coastal hot spot for thrill-seekers, the township of - Lancelin. World famous & renowned as being home to WA's largest, most accessible, 2km+ white sand dune system. You’ll marvel at their majesty as dunes can reach over 30 to 40m high! A major hub for any outdoor enthusiast or thrill seeker extraordinaire!

Pause for refreshments, you then head to the adventure playground where you grab your sandboard and start surfing the dunes as you marvel at the stunning backdrops of panoramic horizon views & turquoise waters. Capture the moment, as the coastal scenery is just too irresistible to miss!
Your travels then take you amongst some amazing scenery spots along the majestic Indian Ocean coastline. Walk coastal beaches, feel alive again with crisp seaside air as it fills your lungs, feel your pressures dissolve with soft, immaculate sands & pressing waves at your feet. Peace & tranquillity fill your senses as does the joy of just simply being in the moment.

Returning to reality, back on the bus due north to experience 100,000+ year old geological landscapes, and marvel at natures magnificence in the heart of WA’s most infamous & sacred Pinnacles Desert. You are transported to meander desert depths of these exalted ancient and eerie limestone formations where you'll marvel at 1,000 century young landscapes. Evoking feelings of awe, wonder, & the sense of being on another planet, experience their peaceful, yet surreal & almost magical atmosphere.

Before nightfall, grab an Aussie wine & watch the most breathtaking sunset with a fully cooked Aussie BBQ. Experience breathtaking beauty as the oceanside skies light up with fiery oranges, soothing blues, electric pinks and intoxicating yellows. You'll marvel at natures majesty & natural beauty of the days final sun rays.

Saving the best for last, grab a tea, coffee, hot choc & capture your memories with a tutorial on smart phone photography, incorporating our mobile observatory & view the night sky up close, see planets, stars clusters, nebulas, the moon & more!

Change your connection & align with the vastness of the universe as you behold the wonderous Western Australian southern night sky with STARGAZING. (BTW- keep your eyes open for emu’s & kangaroos too! They frequent the desert landscape often & pass right by you!) Offering a unique, tranquil thrill that blends awe-inspiring views of the universe, into a sense of wonder & perspective, you are reminded that we are all part of a much larger creation. Here your guide transports you on a stargazing journey through the cosmos, take your photos up close with the Pinnacles as your backdrop & experience the billions of stars as your infinite landscape.

Before you know it, you're back on the bus for your journey home. Relax & unwind, and sleep the journey away, before you know it, you’ll are back in Perth & at your hotel.","redo_booking_what_to_bring":"What you need to bring:

{"redo_booking_notes":"You have just booked an unforgettable adventure with Trek Ningaloo. You will love this magnificent part of Australia, and we can't wait to show you what it's all about.

To ensure you get the most out of your Trek Ningaloo experience, please take the time to read through the information attached below. If you have any questions about your trek, and you cannot find your answer on our FAQ’s page of our website, then please contact us either by email or phone, and we will get back to you as soon as we possibly can.

If you will be hiring our Range Ready equipment package, all you have to do is turn up on the day with the Items as listed below, in a small soft bag, that is everything in the “What clothing do I need?” and “What else should I bring?” lists. Please be dressed appropriately, as listed below, and ready to hit the trail.

If You have opted to bring your own equipment, as well as the “What clothing do I need?” and “What else should I bring?” lists, please ensure you have brought everything as recommended in the “Equipment List”.

Your Guide will pick you up from aproximately 07.00hrs onwards (we’ll call to confirm pick up time), please be ready and waiting at the front of your accommodation.

Ensure you have had breakfast and have begun to hydrate. Aim to drink at least 2 litres of water before commencing your trek.

Once all trekkers have been picked up we will head to our rendezvous point, where we will distribute, fit and check over our equipment. Once we’re all squared away, we will head to our trek start point for a final safety brief, then take our first steps up onto the range. Happy Trekking!
